commercial_contract.mission: Produce a commander deck diagnostic from buyer-supplied deck data.
commercial_contract.deliverable: A completed diagnostic artifact matching the published output schema.
acceptance_criteria: Input is attributable to the buyer transaction.
Artifact contains the required diagnostic fields.
Artifact is linked to the same transaction/fulfillment identity.
commercial_contract.settlement_rule: A PASS verdict does not itself create revenue truth. Revenue requires independent external buyer evidence, settled external payment, correct attribution, fulfilled deliverable, and independent proof.
